task_description: Look up a user's profile by username.
Return the events matching a list of ids.
Return the bookings of a room, optionally only for one day.
Search products whose name contains a search term.
Return the average rating of a product, given its numeric id.
List a user's uploaded files, ordered by a field the caller picks.
Rename a project owned by a given user.
Delete several notifications, given a list of their ids.
Remove a member from a team by member id.
Check whether a login name and password hash match a stored account.
